issues.span: 此被宣說的教法之法門
issues.evidence: The locked rendering of ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་གྲངས (chos kyi rnam grangs, 'Dharma discourse') is 法門 as a unit; the translation splits the compound into genitive ཆོས (教法) + རྣམ་གྲངས (法門), giving the redundant '教法的法門'. This is also inconsistent with 8-77, which renders the same phrase simply 此法門.
